description: This file defines classes and functions for managing FSDP (Fully Sharded Data Parallel) parameters, including sharding, unsharding, and tensor management, with support for DTensors and mesh configurations in distributed training.

classes.name: ShardedState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the sharding state of a parameter: SHARDED, SHARDED_POST_FORWARD, or UNSHARDED.

classes.name: ParamModuleInfo
classes.description: Data class storing module and parameter names for parameter swapping and sharing.

classes.name: ExtensionsData
classes.description: Data class for storing user-defined metadata and all-gather input sizes for extensions.

classes.name: FSDPParam
classes.description: Class managing a sharded parameter with methods for sharding, unsharding, and tensor conversions in distributed training.

methods.name: _init_sharded_param
methods.description: Initializes the sharded parameter, handling tensor sharding, mesh configuration, and tensor padding.

methods.name: _init_sharded_post_forward_param_metadata
methods.description: Sets metadata for post-forward sharded parameters based on the mesh info.

methods.name: init_dtype_attrs
methods.description: Initializes dtype attributes for mixed precision policies.

methods.name: _init_extensions
methods.description: Initializes extension data for all-gather support.

methods.name: init_all_gather_outputs
methods.description: Allocates storage for all-gather output tensors based on input sizes and data types.

methods.name: init_unsharded_param
methods.description: Reconstructs the unsharded parameter from all-gather outputs, handling compile-time invariants.

methods.name: _unflatten_all_gather_outputs
methods.description: Reshapes all-gather output tensors to their original sizes.

methods.name: to_sharded
methods.description: Converts the parameter to its sharded DTensor form and updates module attributes.

methods.name: to_sharded_post_forward
methods.description: Converts the parameter to its post-forward sharded form.

methods.name: to_unsharded
methods.description: Converts the parameter back to its unsharded form.

methods.name: _setattr_on_modules
methods.description: Sets the parameter attribute on the module and shared modules.

methods.name: to_sharded_dtensor
methods.description: Converts a local tensor to a DTensor with sharding spec.

methods.name: to_sharded_post_forward_dtensor
methods.description: Converts a tensor to a DTensor for post-forward sharding.

methods.name: to_accumulated_grad_if_needed
methods.description: Upcasts the gradient to reduce dtype if needed for accumulation.

methods.name: accumulate_unsharded_grad_if_needed
methods.description: Accumulates gradients in unsharded form if applicable.

methods.name: alloc_all_gather_outputs
methods.description: Allocates storage for all-gather output tensors.

methods.name: free_unsharded_param
methods.description: Frees storage of unsharded parameter and related tensors, considering compile mode.

methods.name: all_gather_inputs
methods.description: Property returning tensors to be used as inputs for all-gather, depending on sharding state.

methods.name: unsharded_param
methods.description: Property returning the unsharded nn.Parameter.

methods.name: unsharded_grad_data
methods.description: Returns the inner tensor of the unsharded parameter's gradient.

methods.name: unsharded_accumulated_grad_data
methods.description: Returns the inner tensor of the accumulated gradient.

methods.name: _get_grad_inner_tensor
methods.description: Extracts the local tensor from a gradient, handling DTensors and redistributions.

methods.name: _sharded_local_tensor
methods.description: Property returning the local tensor of the sharded parameter.

methods.name: shard_mesh
methods.description: Returns the mesh used for sharding, handling 1D and 2D meshes.

methods.name: shard_mesh_from_root
methods.description: Returns the mesh for sharding based on the root mesh and dimension names.

methods.name: _assert_in_states
methods.description: Checks if the current sharding state is among expected states.

methods.name: reset_sharded_param
methods.description: Resets or re-pads the sharded parameter, updating local tensor and storage.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of the FSDPParam object.
